properties.text:
7/30 Anti-israel activists took to the streets of Manhattan to bring attention to western media’s role in the ongoing genocide of the Palestinian people and honor the martyrs. 

Impassioned people of conscience rallied outside of NBC, News Corp (home of Fox News, Wall Street Journal and New York Post), Paramount, CBS, New York Times HQ, and marched around Times Square calling out corrupt corporate media’s racist, genocidal lies and shedding light on the truth. 

Activists amplified voices from Gaza, shared statistics and called for the freedom of the 9,400 Palestinian hostages currently in zionist settler-colonial prisons (Palestinian Prisoner’s Information Office, July 22), shared the story of Dr. Hussam Abu Safiya, honored the martyred journalists of Palestine and Lebanon with a special focus on Ismail Al Ghoul and Rami al-Rifi who were beheaded by israel on July 31, 2024, and more. 

🔎 Follow Palestinian journalists for the truth @wizard_bisan1 @nahed_hajjaj99 @zenatahhan & unsubscribe from corporate media’s imperialist lies. 

#FreePalestine #EndTheOccupationNow #ByAnyMeansNecessary
